what: Hand answer key for the path decision (path.mjs dispatch). Written by Fable 5.2 on 2026-11-14 under the owner's rulings of that date. Not a smoke batch: it is read by the path probe, one call per roll.
how_to_score: Score what dispatch() returns, because that is what the generator consumes. A roll is RIGHT when its path is in okPaths AND its body passes. The body rule applies to dispatch()'s print_body when the path is twist, exact or class_npc: needBody true = print_body must be one of okBodies; needBody false with okBodies listed = print_body is null or one of okBodies; okBodies null = print_body must be null. On a homebrew path the body is not scored: dispatch() may carry a 'resembles' body there and the generator does not stand on it. The relation is NOT scored separately. dispatch() returns a twist only when the relation is 'is', and on class_npc the generator stands on a person body whatever the relation (generate.mjs, pathBody). Validate receipts against Name + Description, as StatblockGenerator.vue does. Only entries with counts true go toward the bar; the rest are reported, not scored.
